directive: Keep all decking lines using similar selections to the completed TimberTech form unless a brand/product has a unique requirement. Do not repeat the general questions per brand.

rules.rule: James chooses a color before preview; no automatic first or last-used color.
Group by the brand's real material/product families (TimberTech: Advanced PVC / Composite), then collection. No invented categories.
No favorites or recent list; full verified catalog.
Auto-select a compatible board profile for each role (field, border, divider, stair, fascia); James can review.
Single picture-frame border by default on NEW decks only, rendered only with compatible boards. Saved decks unchanged.
Picture frame starts matching the main deck color; compatible contrast allowed.
Dividers start matching the field color; compatible contrast allowed; divider count and locations preserved.
Fascia starts matching the selected collection/color, only where a real matching fascia exists.
James chooses a compatible stair tread color per staircase; options are the main deck color or the picture-frame color where the product exists.
Closed risers default to the main deck color where a matching riser exists; picture-frame color also offered.
Attached landings inherit the main decking, with independent override; landing geometry preserved.
Product/color selection first; profile-driven board layout and quantities in a later tested phase. No silent quantity or board-width changes.
When the main decking changes, ask whether to keep or replace border/divider color overrides. Never alter geometry, stairs or placement.
Approximate color previews allowed if clearly labeled; replace with measured/licensed assets when available.
Customer concept PDF: manufacturer, collection, color and visual only; no preliminary quantities. Internal estimating independent.

confirmedBy.decision: No product quantities for decking or privacy on customer concept PDFs

ownerNotes.ownerEntry: Defalt devider fascia and pictuerframe all the same color
ownerNotes.treatment: Picture frame, divider and fascia start coordinated, normally in the main deck color. Stored as separate choices; editing one does not change the others unless an 'apply accent to all' interaction is approved.

ownerNotes.ownerEntry: stairstreds and risers ether main decking or pictuer frame color
ownerNotes.treatment: Offer the main-deck and picture-frame colors for treads and risers where the compatible product exists; otherwise show 'selection/technical review required'.

proposedRoleMap.note: Proposed for Q05; depends on AOS's fastening standard (hidden fasteners vs face screws), which is not decided. Not applied until confirmed. Owner closure 11 Nov 2026: board-role profiles, fastening systems and SKUs are a developer/manufacturer verification item, not an open owner decision.

roles.field: grooved where offered (hidden fasteners), else square/solid
roles.stairTread: manufacturer stair tread if offered, else square/solid-edge deck board
roles.riser: manufacturer riser if offered; else manufacturer-described practice, else technical review

persistence: Saved projects keep current board sizing and selections until an approved, tested migration.
Product changes never alter deck shape, dimensions, stairs, railings, dividers, picture-frame locations, landing geometry or unrelated selections.
Manufacturer incompatibilities are surfaced and resolved explicitly; no silent substitution or reset.
notDecided: Accent linking after a manual change.
Supplier and stock for every brand.
unchanged: Overall railing default remains Westbury Tuscany C10, Black Fine Texture.
